What does it take to onboard brands in a B2B setting?

I’m no expert, but just a few days ago, we launched a waitlist for my platform, anchors — and we’ve already had over 75 brands sign up! 😶

(We make influencer marketing easy and results-driven.)

Before launching, we aimed for a healthy mix of small, medium, and large companies across various industries. And guess what? 
We got it. 🙏🏻

I can’t name the brands here, but what warms my heart is that all of them believed in our vision to make influencer marketing accessible by removing the usual hurdles.

We were a bit skeptical about offering Early Access for just ₹1 for a whole year.

But it was so well received.

Maybe that’s what people were waiting for—a chance to try influencer marketing without a big financial commitment.

And I get it! 
As a founder of a bootstrapped company, putting money where you’re unsure of the results is tough.

That’s why our idea of removing upfront costs and focusing on performance was met with such positive feedback.

So, if you ask me, what does it take to onboard brands in B2B? 
I’d say:

► Deliver value. The money will follow.


Right now, I’m just feeling incredibly grateful.


P.S. The waitlist is live, and we’d love to have you on board if you run campaigns and are looking for a solution to make your life easier. 
Link is in comments.

#b2b #marketing #waitlist #influencermarketing #earlyaccess

text.text:
Why Are So Many of My Young Team Members Becoming Startup Founders?

During a recent conversation with the team, I had a surprising realization: three of our ex-employees - Puneet Grover, Aesha Agarwal, and Ravi Ahirwar—have founded their own startups, and 2-3 more have started their own small businesses.

As a founder, there’s nothing more rewarding than seeing people I’ve worked with take the entrepreneurial plunge!

My personal mission has always been about building people and fostering leaders. 
Initially, I believed my impact was measured by the difference I made for the stakeholders of our company - Investors, Clients, Employees. 

But this incident made me realize that true impact goes beyond that. 
Maybe it is reflected in the stories of those who’ve worked alongside me and then gone on to create something of their own.

On this, Aesha Agarwal shared, “Before MyWays.ai, I never thought I’d become a founder or build a startup. But after a while here, the seed unknowingly got planted.”

When I asked what drove their leap into entrepreneurship, they highlighted one crucial factor: the culture and entrepreneurial mindset at MyWays.ai

According to them, working at MyWays.ai never felt like just being part of a team of employees. It was a group of people who shared the same entrepreneurial spirit.

And rightly so, I’ve always told my team they aren’t just clocking in hours—they’re here to make an impact.

Witnessing how this approach ignites innovation and encourages bold moves is deeply fulfilling.

It’s moments like these that remind me—impact isn’t just about numbers or users. 
It’s about the lives we touch, the leaders we cultivate, and the futures we help shape.

P.S. Ravi Ahirwar and Aesha Agarwal are reshaping an entire industry with their platform anchors It’s a whole new way to look at influencer marketing—Influencer Marketing 2.0! 
Their waitlist is open, offering Early Access perks, including a 1-year subscription for just ₹1. Check it out - https://lnkd.in/djSCBDmF

Because they have questions no one has been able to answer for them -
➡️Where do we begin
➡️Do we have to speak to the creators
➡️How do we decide which creators are the best
➡️What results can we expect
➡️What if we do not get those results

WHAT IF you do not get those results? Right now, it's nothing but pin-drop silence mixed with '"it's not in our control".

But what if there was an answer all along and a mighty good one at that?

With Influencer Marketing 2.0, 

you get answers to all these questions and more. Here's a glimpse of what it will look like-
✔️Clear results, based on CPM
✔️A pay-for-what-you-get model: so you no more stress over the what-ifs
✔️ZERO upfront charges, because how would you know if it will work for you unless you try it out
✔️Campaign-level matching, because a single brand can have many moods and needs

Influencer Marketing 2.0 will be easy and affordable—just as simple as booking an Uber.

My co-founder, Aesha, and I are proud to introduce Influencer Marketing 2.0 through anchors to the world.
And we CANNOT wait to see what you think of it.
